q: What is the carbon footprint of a packaged drinking water plant per litre?
title: Packaged drinking water per litre
short: At the plant, electricity for RO, ozonation and filling is the main own source, at 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh. The bottles usually weigh more in the total: PET preforms and caps are Scope 3. Divide the month's total by litres filled.

ul: Scope 2: RO, pumps, ozone, blow moulding, filling.

p: Returnable 20 litre jars spread their plastic over many refills, so they carry far less packaging per litre.

senseible: Senseible reads the plant's electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and fuel invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record, the plant-level input to a per-unit figure. Bought-in materials go to the supplier evidence trail; product reports are self-declared drafts.

sources.label: CEA CO2 Baseline Database for the Indian Power Sector
